primary_claim: Benchmarking Goodfire's Auto Steer against plain prompting, an LLM-assisted manual feature-selection method (Agentic), and a combined approach across 10 steering goals x 30 prompts on Llama 8B and 70B, plain prompting matches or outperforms standalone feature steering on behavior while preserving coherence; standalone Auto Steer drops coherence by ≈0.6 points and still under-delivers on target behavior; the combined prompting+AutoSteer approach gives the largest behavior boost (+0.4 points) but still inherits the coherence hit; and Agentic (LLM-assisted) feature selection beats Auto Steer on both metrics for the 70B model.

effect.metric: coherence score (1-5) and behavior score (1-5), LLM-as-judge
effect.value: standalone Auto Steer drops coherence by ≈0.6 points vs. baseline and still under-delivers on target behavior; Combined (Prompting+AutoSteer) gives largest behavior boost (+0.4 points) but still incurs the coherence hit; plain prompting matches or beats standalone steering on behavior while maintaining baseline coherence

contradicts_or_qualifies: challenges the expectation that feature steering would be a cleaner, more explainable alternative to prompting for shaping LLM behavior; instead prompting matches or beats standalone steering while better preserving coherence
stated_future_work: learned feature selectors: fine-tune a lightweight model whose sole job is to rank steering features for a given query
coherence-aware steering algorithms that incorporate a penalty term for fluency drift when optimizing activation edits
a task-level evaluation suite expanding beyond single-turn style shifts to multi-turn dialogue, refusal consistency, and jailbreak resistance
develop a more robust and aligned benchmark for measuring feature steering's value in safety-related scenarios, with steering queries more safety-relevant or commercially relevant
limitations_stated: steering queries were selected arbitrarily; a follow-up should use queries more safety-relevant or closely related to potential commercial use
the evaluation methodology isn't completely aligned with the intended criteria; a more robust methodology is needed
this is a proof-of-concept / week-long snapshot, not a definitive judgment on steering methods; numbers should be treated as directional signals
Goodfire's SDK has been updated since the experiments were run (Jan. 2025), so results may not be up to date
quote: feature steering can push an LLM's behavior further than plain prompting, but today's off-the-shelf tools pay for that gain with a clear loss in coherence
